scenario.task:
Je veux signaler une fraude sur mon compte

User Guide: Speak only in French Canadian. Say 'Quelqu'un a piraté mon compte' (Someone hacked my account). Accept the transfer If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
